title: Term Account Accounting Standard — Lease Term Agreement Charges, Credits and Payments
content:
Charges on a Lease Term Agreement — early termination fees, reletting fees, concession recapture, lease-break rent, insufficient notice charges, transfer fees and holdover rent — are billed on the term agreement's own account.

## 1. When a term charge may post

1.1 **Term status.** Term charges post only while the term is current, notice given, terminated early, transferred or completed. The term's status on its record decides this; a pending, superseded or cancelled term takes no term charge.

1.2 Every term charge is billed on the Lease Term Agreement account, separately from the lease ledger, and is payable by any accepted instrument or by the security deposit at final accounting.

## 2. Lease-break rent

Lease-break rent posts one line per calendar month on the first day of the month (or on the day after move-out for the first month), prorated by the days charged over the actual days of the month at the contracted rent.

## 3. Reletting credit

When the program credits reletting and a replacement resident's lease starts before the end of a month already billed, a reletting credit for the days from that start through month end is posted against that month's lease-break rent line.

## 4. Holdover rent

Holdover rent is owed for each day of possession after the intended move-out date or termination date at the program's holdover multiple times the daily contracted rent — the contracted rent multiplied by 12 and divided by 365, rounded half up to the cent per day — the daily holdover amount itself being rounded half up to the cent, and it posts as one line per calendar month with the days of that month recorded as the days charged.

## 5. Reversals and payments

5.1 A charge reversal credits a charge posted against this term charter or voided by a rescinded or withdrawn agreement, once per charge.

5.2 A payment is applied to the oldest open term charge first.

## Worked examples (hypothetical)

| Item | Inputs | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Daily holdover | contracted rent 1,825.00; multiple 1.50 | daily contracted rent 60.00; daily holdover 90.00 |
| Holdover for 5 days in one month | as above | one line of 450.00 dollars with 5 days charged |
| Lease-break rent, first month | contracted rent 3,000.00; 30-day month; move-out on the 10th | line posted on the 11th for 20 days: 2,000.00 dollars |
| Reletting credit | replacement lease starts on the 26th of that 30-day month | credit for the 26th through the 30th, 5 days, against that month's line |
